_comment: S0-v2 B4 ruleset target — updated by #1177 for the Security aggregator. The live ruleset still reflects the pre-#1177 state until #1180 performs the one-shot PUT. The target required_checks list is the 24-context end state (23 package/quality contexts plus Security), and the guard test .github/scripts/test_ci_contract.rb asserts every target name has a producing job check-run.
_retired_contexts_status: Historical record: these 6 contexts were deleted from the live ruleset in the 2026-08-06 PUT. main HEAD check-runs still show them because main still runs the pre-B4 ci.yml until this PR merges.

_deferred_required.reason: Still NOT required after the 2026-08-06 PUT. At flip time the lane was red on main HEAD: the retired Infra component CI's Pulumi preview (staging) failed with an R2 state backend 401 Unauthorized (credentials issue, orchestrator-owned). The R2 keys were subsequently re-issued and the old lane is green on main HEAD (verified 2026-08-06), but the new pipeline-infra.yml lane has not yet run on main, and the step-level dorny preview gate means a path-skipped run produces no preview at all. Re-add only when the new lane is consecutively green.
re_add_conditions: pipeline-infra.yml 'Infra / build' green on consecutive main/PR runs
the step-level dorny preview gate (BLOCK-2b) is confirmed — a path-skipped job produces no check-run, which is the second reason it must not be required until the gate and the lane are both stable
B7's REQUIRED_CONTEXTS table is updated in the same batch as the ruleset PUT

_deferred_required.reason: Backlog item, not in the live ruleset. This is the only gate that boots the real esbuild bundle in workerd and catches bundle-only startup failures (the StringChunk TDZ that blocked staging deploys, 2026-08-05); vitest evaluates unbundled modules and cannot see them. The job runs unconditionally on pull_request and merge_group in pipeline-catalog.yml (its workflow declares merge_group), so making it required cannot strand the merge queue — the check-run always appears. Add in a future PUT once this PR's pipeline-catalog.yml has gone green on main.
re_add_conditions: pipeline-catalog.yml 'Catalog startup smoke (bundled boot)' green on main after this PR merges
B7's REQUIRED_CONTEXTS table is updated in the same batch as the ruleset PUT

_check_gates.status: pending one-shot cutover (#1180) — ci.yml now produces one fail-closed Security result on pull_request, merge_group, push, and workflow_dispatch; the old child contexts remain historical until the live ruleset PUT.

_notes: RETENTION-1 (2026-08-10, #940): the three 'Maintenance / *' contexts were removed from required_checks (now 32) because pipeline-maintenance.yml was deleted with the retired jobs Worker. The live ruleset must drop them in the same change that removes the lane (guard: test_ci_contract.rb asserts every name here has a producing job check-run).

APPLIED STATE (verified via gh api repos/lifeodyssey/animichi/rulesets/19974534 on 2026-08-06 after the orchestrator's hard-switch PUT): enforcement=active, bypass_actors=[], conditions ~DEFAULT_BRANCH, required_status_checks = the pre-#1177 snapshot. The #1177 Security aggregator target is pending the #1180 one-shot PUT; the six historical retired contexts remain recorded above.

HISTORICAL (pre-PUT, 2026-08-06): the live ruleset had exactly 9 contexts — the 6 retired lanes + Web / lint + Web / test + Web / build. The one-shot PUT deleted the 6 and added the 23 new stage/security contexts; Web / lint|test|build were already required by B1's union step and stayed. The #1177/#1180 change replaces the nine child security contexts with one top-level Security result; the live replacement is intentionally a separate one-shot operation.
Quality / invariants IS required since the PUT (it was NOT before — it is one of the 23 added).

codecov/patch is NOT in the live ruleset (verified post-PUT): the 95% changed-line verdict is not enforced as a status gate. The repo-side patch-coverage policy check lives in pipeline-quality.yml ('Verify patch coverage policy'); it does not make codecov/patch a required check. Re-adding codecov/patch as a real required status is a tracked backlog item in docs/ops/deployment.md.

Context names are GitHub check-run names, not job ids. The Security context is produced by the top-level ci.yml aggregator; its child scans remain visible under the non-required Security scans reusable workflow. The aggregator runs on pull_request, merge_group, push, and workflow_dispatch and fails closed when child evidence is incomplete.

MERGE-GATE TRAP — target covered: a required context that never produces on merge_group hangs the merge queue. The top-level Security aggregator is in ci.yml, which declares on.merge_group (branches: [main]); the live ruleset PUT in #1180 must add Security and remove the nine historical child names together. Every pipeline-*.yml lane declares merge_group on main by contract (test_ci_contract.rb enforces the shape).

Catalog startup smoke (bundled boot) is a backlog item, not required (see _deferred_required): the job exists in pipeline-catalog.yml and its check-run is produced unconditionally on PR/merge_group runs, so it can be added by a future PUT without queue risk.
